name: Incotex
why: The Venetian trouser specialist since 1951 — the Slowear group's founding house; chinos and flannels cut with tailoring discipline and nothing else made.
origin: Venice, 1951 — a trouser factory that stayed a trouser factory; anchor of the Slowear group, which built a slow-fashion federation around it.
opview: Positions specialization as the argument — one garment, perfected.

notes.cotton: the chino benchmark — the pair the specialty shops fit everything else against
notes.craft: Venetian production, one product category since 1951
notes.ital: Trousers only, made in the Veneto, and a specialist inside the Slowear group. The narrowness is the point: a house that has spent decades on one garment.

marks: Tropical Wool (7). LICENSED: SUMMERTIME fabric by Loro Piana (1)
